AFT-RAIL SURVEY WITH SPYGLASS — leaning one hip against the aft rail, spyglass raised to his eye, free hand resting on the rail, hair streaming forward from behind, the churned prop-wash of cloud spiraling out in his wake under a vast indigo mid-night sky

MAST-TOP PLATFORM SENTINEL — standing at ease on the small mast-top platform, arms loosely at his sides, one hand resting on a short brass stay-wire, hair lifting in slow gusts, a wall of luminous cumulus towers rising on both sides like a natural throne

CROW'S-NEST SOVEREIGN — standing tall in the crow's-nest with both hands gripping the brass rim, chin lifted and eyes locked on the horizon, as a burning amber sunset ignites the cloudbank below and the great envelope looms behind him like a second sky

YARD-ARM EDGE AT DAWN — seated on the port yard-arm with one boot dangling and one knee braced against the spar, brass spyglass raised to his eye, as first light bleeds gold across a sea of violet cloud stretching to infinity beneath him

FORESTAY HANG AT ZENITH — gripping the forestay with both hands and leaning back over open air, body arced like a bowsprit figurehead, hair streaming horizontal, while a pillar of noon-white cloud erupts behind him and the sun haloes his silhouette

SHROUD-CLIMB HALF-HEIGHT — frozen mid-climb on the port shroud, one hand higher than the other, one boot pressed into the ratline, turning his head to look down at the camera from a dizzying angle as silver storm light floods from below

SIGNAL-LANTERN VIGIL — braced at the top of the main mast with one arm wrapped around the pole and the other raising a signal-lantern into deep indigo dusk, its amber beam cutting through wisps of cloud that curl past him like smoke

PROW OVERHANG STILLNESS — standing on the very tip of the gondola prow, arms at his sides, spine perfectly upright, staring into an oncoming wall of luminous white cloud that swallows the world ahead while the wind hauls his hair straight back

STARBOARD SHROUD LEAN — wrapped one-handed around the starboard shroud at full arm's extension, body tilted forty-five degrees over open sky, sextant held out at chest height as the late-afternoon sun turns the cloudtops to molten copper far below

TOP-SPAR LOOKOUT — lying prone along the top yard-arm with his chest flat on the spar, chin resting on one fist and the other hand dangling a brass spyglass toward the cloud-floor, as twin shafts of cathedral light pierce the overcast beneath him

MAST-CAP CROUCH — crouched atop the bare mast-cap with both hands resting on bent knees, body low and coiled, surveying a moonlit cloudscape through narrowed eyes while a ring of silver mist circles the mast far below like a slow-moving tide

RIGGING CROSS-BRACE STAND — standing upright on the intersection of two bracing lines, arms spread wide and each hand locking a separate shroud, framed against a colossal cumulonimbus lit from within by lightning that pulses gold and violet behind him

BOWSPRIT STRADDLE — straddling the angled bowsprit with both hands flat on the spar ahead of him, leaning forward into the slipstream, hair erupting forward, as a sunrise so red it looks on fire bleeds up from the cloudline directly into his face

RATLINE PAUSE — standing easy on a mid-height ratline with one elbow hooked over the shroud above and an astrolabe swinging loose from his other hand, glancing sidelong at the camera while a squadron of small clouds races past at eye level

CROW'S-NEST TURN — pivoting in the crow's-nest on one heel with one hand still on the rim and the other pressed to his chest holding a folded star-chart, body caught mid-rotation, as the last ember of sunset paints half his form gold and leaves the rest in shadow

UPPER-MAST FLAG-LINE — one boot on the cleat, one arm stretched high gripping a flag-halyard, body elongated into a near-vertical line, staring upward as a vast aurora unfurls in green and white curtains across a starfield directly above him

YARD-ARM TIP OVERHANG — dangling both legs off the extreme tip of the starboard yard-arm, one hand white-knuckled on the spar and the other holding a signal-flare that streams vivid red smoke into the dark twilight, clouds swirling far beneath his boots

CATWALK RAIL LEAN — leaning both forearms on the highest catwalk rail with fingers loosely laced, body canted forward, watching a storm cell rotate beneath the ship while lightning threads through the clouds below and the rail vibrates under his weight
